title: Around the world in five weeks
tagline: Seven stops on five continents — a demo of the globe view
intro: A demo trip for the globe: Reykjavík, New York, Kyoto, Hanoi and Ha Long, Sydney, Cape Town and home to Zurich. Four of the stops carry a simulated recorded route along real streets; the other three have photographs and a place only. Every photograph is from Wikimedia Commons and credited in its caption.
